text: The burden{H4853} of Moab.{H4124} For in a night{H3915} Ar{H6144} of Moab{H4124} is laid waste,{H7703} [and] brought to nought;{H1820} for in a night{H3915} Kir{H7024} of Moab{H4124} is laid waste,{H7703} [and] brought to nought.{H1820}

Therefore the abundance{H3502} they have gotten,{H6213} and that which they have laid up,{H6486} shall they carry away{H5375} over the brook{H5158} of the willows.{H6155}
